Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly applied a complex and unnecessary "small-solute w/w mass-fraction adjustment" formula ($m_{water\_effective} = m_{water} \times (1 - w)$) to a basic conservation of mass problem. In reality, mass is conserved; mixing salt and water simply adds their masses together ($25g + 1000g = 1025g$). The Planner's logic artificially reduced the water mass and then added the salt back to arrive at 1000g, which is physically incorrect and leads to the wrong answer (Option B) instead of the correct answer (Option C).
